narrative.summary: Cells from 4 donors were compared after treatment and after vehicle, with each donor's pair analysed together. 412 genes changed significantly: 251 were higher and 161 lower after treatment. GENEA1 showed the largest increase (log2 fold change 4.21), and GENEB7 the largest decrease. The main source of variation between samples (PC1, 61.3% of the variance) separates treated from vehicle samples. Genes in HALLMARK_EXAMPLE_RESPONSE tended to be higher after treatment. No quality warnings were raised.
key_findings: 412 genes pass the significance rule (padj < 0.05 and |shrunken log2FC| > 1): 251 higher and 161 lower in treated.
GENEA1 is the strongest increase (log2 fold change 4.21, adjusted p-value 3.1e-40).
Treatment explains most of PC1 (61.3% of the variance between samples).
HALLMARK_EXAMPLE_RESPONSE is the top pathway higher in treated samples (NES 2.41).
narrative.sample_structure: PC1 (61.3% of the variance) separates treated from vehicle samples, and treatment explains almost all of it. No sample was flagged as a possible outlier or mislabel.
narrative.gene_highlights: Among genes higher after treatment, GENEA1 (example gene A1) stands out with a log2 fold change of 4.21. Among genes lower after treatment, GENEB7 (example gene B7) has the largest decrease (log2 fold change -3.05).
narrative.pathway_highlights: Gene-set enrichment analysis, which looks at all genes ranked from most higher to most lower, found HALLMARK_EXAMPLE_RESPONSE higher in treated samples (NES 2.41, adjusted p-value 1.0e-6).
caveats: With 4 donors per group, smaller changes may be missed.
next_steps: Confirm GENEA1 and GENEB7 by qPCR in independent samples.
Look at the genes behind HALLMARK_EXAMPLE_RESPONSE in the pathway table to see which ones drive the result.
